name: @noelle/linkedin-client
description: LinkedIn Voyager API client (READ-ONLY) for the LinkedIn intern (Lyra). Mints a fresh JSESSIONID from li_at (the stale DevTools one 403s), then reads member post feeds, profiles, and connections. No write/send/comment/DM paths exist by design — Lyra never posts to LinkedIn. Behind the LinkedInClient interface so a browser (Playwright) impl can replace Voyager without touching callers.
